heading: Procedure for indictable offences that may be heard and determined summarily
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "30", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "30", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text:
The informant or the accused may apply for a
summary hearing under section 29(1).

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "30", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text:
Without any application under subsection (1), the
Magistrates' Court may offer a summary hearing
under section 29(1).

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "30", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text:
An application for, or an offer of, a summary
hearing may be made at any time before the
Magistrates' Court determines whether to commit
the accused for trial.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "30", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text:
Section 6(4) provides that an informant may include a
request for a committal proceeding in a charge-sheet
containing a charge for an indictable offence that may be
heard and determined summarily.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "30", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text:
If an application for a summary hearing is
made before the hearing of any evidence, the
Magistrates' Court may seek from the prosecutor
or, if the informant is appearing in person, the
informant and he or she must give—
for the purpose of enabling the court to determine
whether to grant a summary hearing.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "30", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text:
an outline of the evidence which will be
presented for the prosecution; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "30", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text:
any other information which the court
considers relevant—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "30", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text:
Any statement made by the prosecutor or
informant under subsection (4) is not admissible
in evidence in any subsequent proceeding in
respect of the charge.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "30", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text:
If the Magistrates' Court grants a summary
hearing, the hearing and determination of the
charge must be conducted in accordance with
Part 3.3.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "30", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text:
Sections 112A to 113D of the Sentencing Act 1991 provide
for maximum penalties in the Magistrates' Court.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "30", "subsection": "7", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text:
Subject to subsection (8), if—
the court may, with the consent of the accused,
admit as evidence in the summary hearing—
given or tendered during the committal hearing.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "30", "subsection": "7", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "30", "subsection": "7", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text:
the Magistrates' Court subsequently grants a
summary hearing—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "30", "subsection": "7", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the oral evidence of any witness; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "30", "subsection": "7", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the statement of any witness; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "30", "subsection": "7", "paragraph": "e", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "30", "subsection": "8", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If evidence is admitted under subsection (7)—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "30", "subsection": "8", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text:
the Magistrates' Court must, at the request of
the informant or the accused, call or recall
(as the case requires) any witness for
examination or cross-examination; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "3", "part": "3.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "30", "subsection": "8", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text:
the hearing must otherwise be conducted in
the same manner as a proceeding for a
summary offence.
